page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, the instance features 4 physical cores with 1 thread per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and includes a 35 MB L3 cache. The hardware configuration lacks local storage and dedicated GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers of modern cloud hardware. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests yielded scores of 1100.98 and 2934.04 respectively, both falling into the bottom 25% of benchmarked systems. Memory bandwidth tests show a significant drop from 164.0 GB/sec for small cached blocks to 21.27 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, which is categorized in the bottom 10%. Similarly, static web serving throughput of 2.52 GB/sec and gzip compression of 18.97 GB/sec reflect lower-tier performance metrics.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.xlarge offers a balanced resource allocation for legacy or non-demanding workloads where high-performance throughput is not a primary requirement. Given the weak performance in database operations and Redis SET operations, this instance is best suited for low-traffic web serving, basic application testing, lightweight background tasks, and general-purpose utility workloads that do not demand high memory bandwidth or intensive computational power.
